died.name: Charles II of England
died.last_words: I have been a most unconscionable time dying, but I beg you to excuse it.

died.name: Joseph Priestley
died.desc: English chemist, natural philosopher and theologian
died.cause: while dictating revisions to his works
died.last_words: That is right; I have now done.

died.name: Billy Whelan
died.cause: during British European Airways Flight 609's third takeoff attempt prior to the Munich air disaster
died.last_words: If this is death, then I am ready for it.

born.name: Chongzhen Emperor
born.desc: the last emperor of Ming dynasty
born.last_words: It has been seventeen years since I ascended the throne. I, feeble and of small virtue, have offended against Heaven; the rebels have seized my capital because my ministers deceived me. Ashamed to face my ancestors, I die. Removing my imperial cap and with my hair disheveled about my face, I leave to the rebels the dismemberment of my body. Let them not harm my people!

born.name: Anne, Queen of Great Britain
born.cause: handing the Lord High Treasurer's staff of office to Charles Talbot, 1st Duke of Shrewsbury
born.last_words: Use it for the good of my people.

born.name: Andrew Fuller
born.desc: English Particular Baptist minister and theologian
born.last_words: I have no religious joys; but I have a hope, in the strength of which I think I could plunge into eternity.

born.name: Aaron Burr
born.desc: vice president of the United States
